title: Th3 Cha0s (horror)
description: A timeline where a corrupt entity take minecraft
body:
# Welcome to **Th3 Cha0s**

## Things that you need to know

*   This mod can corrupt your world (for now)
*   This mod isn't a virus or anything else (i made it on mcreator)
*   This mod can't control your pc like the broken script
*   This mod can have some flashing light
*   This mod is inspired by The Broken Script or no_moon.jar (but it have is own story & idea)
*   This mod is an *ARG MOD*
*   This mod doesn't work with other *ARG MOD*
*   I gonna update this mod for only 1.20.1 until Th3 Cha0s 2 is in dev
*   Feel free to made your own Th3 Cha0s mod (just tell that this one is the original)

## What is **The Chaos**

Th3 Cha0s is a new horror mod that i made in my freetime. i decide to make it because i really like horror community in minecraft. This mod is 100% safe, i made it on mcreator & the only thing that he can do out of minecraft is open a screenshot.. (for now)

## Project Artificiali

Welcome to project artificiali, a version of minecraft 1.20.1 in a timeline where notch still develop minecraft. Minecraft popularity fall out and the last know version is the 1.20… You received by an ex-employe of Mojang the last save of the 1.20.1 that is a corrupt version with some strange event in it.

## Features

Some of the features of the more are :

### Entity

*   The\_Good : an entity that is safe, but when you kill too much mob or hurt him, he became the most dangerous entity ever (i think)
*   The\_Trader : He came to you, sometime.. he just want you to give him a thing or to kill something. i think that if you dont do it you gonna die so..
*   err555 : i dont know anything of him exept that i see him on the tab menu & that he always look at me.
*   The\_Gotow : he is like the urban legend of the Goatman, but he hate the light (& you..) \[coming soon\]

### Effect

The mod add many random effect on the player POV & random event
